title: Creamy American Sausage Baked Casserole
description: A rich and flavorful casserole featuring American sausages, onions, and a creamy sauce, perfect for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: American sausages (4-6)
ingredients.notes: you can use any type of American sausage you like

instructions: Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with olive oil.
Cook the sausages in a large skillet over medium-high heat, browning them on all sides. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
In a separate saucepan, whisk together the flour and milk until smooth, then bring to a simmer over medium heat until thickened.
Stir in the grated cheddar cheese until melted, then remove from heat.
Add the cooked onion and garlic mixture to the cheese sauce, followed by the diced tomatoes, green chilies, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked sausages, cheese sauce mixture, and chopped parsley (if using).
Transfer the sausage mixture to the prepared baking dish and top with additional grated cheese if desired.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
